###### Industry recognition highlights AmpliTech’s innovation in open, interoperable 5G radio access solutions


HAUPPAUGE, N.Y., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — AmpliTech Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMPG) (the “Company”), a developer of advanced RF and microwave technologies and Open RAN radio solutions, today announced that it has been named Winner of the Open RAN Champion for Innovation at The Fast Mode Awards 2026 in the Telecoms Solution Provider category.


The award, announced by telecom industry publication The Fast Mode on November 3, 2026, recognizes AmpliTech’s achievements in the innovation dimension of Open RAN. Other recipients within the Open RAN Champion category include Capgemini for Performance, Rakuten Symphony for Impact and P.I. Works for Growth.


AmpliTech continues to develop an expanding portfolio of Open RAN radio solutions to support flexible, interoperable network deployments. Its work spans radio configurations for macro networks, enterprise and private 5G applications, with an emphasis on RF performance, multi-vendor interoperability and giving operators more choice in how they build next-generation wireless networks. AmpliTech plans to build on this recognition through continued radio innovation, ecosystem collaboration and engagement with network operators and systems integrators pursuing open, scalable 5G deployments.


Mr. Fawad Maqbool, CEO/CTO of AmpliTech Group, commented: “We are honored to receive the Open RAN Champion Innovation Award from The Fast Mode. This recognition reflects our team’s dedication to developing innovative, high-performance Open RAN solutions that address the evolving needs of wireless network operators worldwide. As the industry continues its transition toward open, interoperable, and flexible network architectures, AmpliTech remains committed to delivering American-engineered technology that supports the next generation of wireless connectivity. This award further underscores our growing industry recognition and the progress we are making in strengthening our brand, expanding our market presence, and positioning AmpliTech as a leading innovator in this strategically important growth market.”


As part of this recognition, AmpliTech Group has been invited to attend the official awards ceremony taking place in conjunction with The Fast Mode LiveX Kuala Lumpur 2027, scheduled for January 25–26, 2027, at the InterContinental Kuala Lumpur in Malaysia. The Company intends to participate in this international industry gathering and accept its Open RAN Champion, Innovation Award in person.


LiveX KL 2027 will bring together telecommunications operators, technology providers, and industry leaders to explore advancements in artificial intelligence, next-generation connectivity, and digital infrastructure. AmpliTech views its participation as an opportunity to further strengthen its global industry visibility, engage with potential customers and strategic partners, and reinforce its commitment to advancing Open RAN innovation worldwide.


**About AmpliTech Group, Inc.:**


AmpliTech Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMPG, AMPGW) designs, develops, and manufactures advanced RF and microwave signal-processing components and systems for satellite, 5G/6G telecom, quantum computing, defense, and space applications. Its five divisions, AmpliTech Inc., Specialty Microwave, Spectrum Semiconductor Materials, AmpliTech Group Microwave Design Center, and AmpliTech Group 5G Divisions work symbiotically and serve customers worldwide. Through continuous innovation and U.S.-based manufacturing, AmpliTech is enabling the next generation of connectivity and communication systems. **About The Fast Mode:**


The Fast Mode is an independent research and digital media publication delivering news, analysis, and insights covering the global telecommunications and technology industries. Founded in 2013, the publication focuses on emerging technologies and innovations in 5G/6G, Open RAN, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, network infrastructure, and digital services. Through its editorial coverage, industry research, and recognition programs, including The Fast Mode Awards, it highlights organizations and technologies helping shape the future of global connectivity.
